description: This file defines a Python class `GrafanaClient` that provides an asynchronous HTTP client to interact with the Grafana REST API. It includes methods for sending GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, handling authentication via API key, and error handling with logging.

classes.name: GrafanaClient
classes.description: A thin HTTP client to perform authenticated requests to Grafana's REST API asynchronously.

methods.description: Performs an HTTP request asynchronously, with error handling and response processing.
